narratives.narrative: The simulator models loss of availability zone eu-west-1a, which removes the public subnet aws_subnet.public_a. This directly affects two components in the blast radius: the payments load balancer (aws_lb.payments) and the NAT gateway in that zone (aws_nat_gateway.nat_a). Detectability is high because the failure is modeled explicitly. Impact is assessed as affecting two tier‑1‑critical components. Likelihood and recoverability dimensions are not assessable from the structural analysis alone, as no frequency/probability data exists and recoverability is evaluated per‑resource rather than at the zone level.

The finding assesses an AZ loss of eu‑west‑1a data subnet (aws_subnet.data_a). Detectability is high because the simulator models the failure directly. Impact is assessed as 4 components in the blast radius with workload criticality tier1. Likelihood is not assessable due to lack of frequency/probability data. Recoverability dimensions (failover_path_exists, rpo_feasible) are not assessable because recoverability is evaluated per affected resource, not at the zone‑kill level. No existing mitigation is stated.
